horizontal_reconstruction: Native four-pixel groups are read atomically with the same address cadence as effect blocks; native RGB565 outside displaced 4-pixel blocks; even-pixel-centred [1,2,1]/4 filtered 640x720 effect plane, 2x RGB565 interpolation with cross-word lookahead and right-edge clamp inside waves and all transitions
hardware_validation: User reported successful single-board acceptance on 2026-10-17 for this delivered build.
bmp_input: 24-bit uncompressed bottom-up BMP: 640x480, 1280x720, 1920x1080 and legal sizes within 640..1920 by 360..1080. Runtime FPGA scaler produces 1280x720; native-sized sources bypass interpolation. The loader additionally derives a horizontally even-pixel-centred [1,2,1]/4 filtered 640x720 effect plane; both planes are generated on FPGA from the same BMP.
monitor_diagnostic: User reports internal TPG visible in the 75MHz nominal-720p60 mode; nominal-720p30 mode black.
sdram_read_contract: Four consecutive aligned words per SDR burst. Only sequential row requests reach SDRAM; all ripple/random reads use a 32-row on-chip cache.

optimization.baseline: Seven-DSP build 91e24a4abf33f4db42b7bd3a71c83314ba1a43c2b0eecd054a6814a3afcfbecb; 12811 routed LUT. This baseline itself was not board-confirmed
optimization.square_implementation: Symmetric bit-pair square with carry-save compression; sqrt comparison reuses subtraction sign
optimization.result_equivalence: Integer coordinates, RGB565 blend rounding, lighting and image data remain bit-exact; external pipeline latency and throughput are unchanged
optimization.blend_implementation: Four-row radix-four Booth recoding with carry-save reduction; exact rounding and four-edge latency
optimization.constant_products: Explicit shift/add for 3x, 5x, 6x and power-of-two coordinate arithmetic
optimization.native_cache_packing: 512 direct four-pixel entries plus a 128-entry two-slot byte-dual-port tail. Six RAM9K, unchanged atomic read latency; destination half-plane and native dwell share the same store.

audio.format: 48000Hz signed16 stereo, left shifted by 8 into HDMI signed24
audio.diagnostic_key: KEY2 short: drop; hold 1s: music -> digital zero -> 1kHz -18dBFS sine -> music
audio.status_digit: Second digit from right: mode in bits3:2, sticky PCM underrun in bit1, SDR read timeout in bit0
audio.source_hiss: Previous BGM1 was confirmed clean by the user. Current selection is Time is Broken, decoded locally to 48kHz signed16 stereo without denoising or gain changes. AUD payload is byte-exact to the converted WAV; source quality and live playback still need listening verification.

transition_handoff: All eleven effects use progress 0..256 and show a native destination frame before commit. Native and effect paths use one four-pixel coordinate per block. SW2 still offers a forced effect-plane comparison.

Orthographic card flip with projected texture and illuminated rim
Eight staggered ribbons with curved edges and eased motion
Liquid metal front with local refraction and silver rim
Slanted glass fragments with staggered horizontal movement
Horizontal tunnel with contracting and expanding texture projections
Viscous curved split with independently displaced halves
